requirements.text: Patients should be able to book and cancel appointments online with a user-friendly calendar that shows available times and providers.
Patients should be able to request repeat prescriptions easily by selecting from a list of their medications and potentially adding notes.
Patients should be able to view their test results online after a doctor has reviewed them, ensuring secure access.
The portal must have a secure login process to protect patient information, ensuring that only authorized individuals can access their own data.
The overall design should prioritize simplicity and ease of use, particularly for older patients or those less comfortable with technology.
